meta.scope: i18n key drift hunt + axe-core cross-surface aggregation
meta.method: static analysis of compiled JS + JSON locales + existing axe.json artifacts

color-contrast.help: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds

scrollable-region-focusable.help: Scrollable region must have keyboard access

region.help: All page content should be contained by landmarks

color-contrast.help: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds

heading-order.help: Heading levels should only increase by one

nested-interactive.help: Interactive controls must not be nested

aria-dialog-name.help: ARIA dialog and alertdialog nodes should have an accessible name

aria-progressbar-name.help: ARIA progressbar nodes must have an accessible name

axe_aggregation.note: Only KDS (1 surface) and Mobile-A11y wave (12 surfaces) have persisted axe results. POS/OSS/Kiosk/STOCK/LIVREUR/WEB axe artifacts NOT captured in goal-pageby-2026-05-18 round-1.

findings.title: i18n parity drift fr→en (75 fr keys orphan in en, 194 en keys orphan in fr)
findings.reproduction: node + flatten(fr.json) vs flatten(en.json), diff sets
findings.evidence: 75 keys defined in fr.json have NO en translation; 194 keys defined in en.json have NO fr translation. Total 269 inconsistent. Examples: label.cash_session_open/close (fr-only), menu.customer_app/deliveryBoys (en-only).
findings.recommendation: V1.0.X heal — Auto-import script to sync key sets, then human translator pass; prioritize POS/Kiosk/KDS labels.

findings.title: i18n parity drift fr→ar (239 fr keys orphan in ar)
findings.evidence: 239 fr keys not present in ar.json. Arabic locale is 12.7% behind French (1840 vs 1887 keys raw count, but 239 NOT covered).
findings.recommendation: V1.0.X — sync ar.json with fr.json key set. Block ar enablement until parity >= 95% on POS+Kiosk namespaces.

findings.title: Axe coverage gap — 6 surfaces lack persisted axe-results in goal-pageby-2026-05-18 round-1
findings.evidence: Only KDS has axe-results.json. POS (12 pages), BORNE (Kiosk), OSS, STOCK, SYNC, LIVREUR surfaces have wave-findings.json but NO axe-results.json. Cannot certify WCAG AA across V1 production surfaces.
findings.recommendation: V1.0.X — Add @axe-core/playwright to each goal-pageby surface spec; persist results per surface. Required for V1 production-perfect audit.

findings.title: KDS color-contrast — 9 nodes serious (4.5:1 expected, actual 3.63:1)
findings.evidence: class .kds-card__shortcut foreground #6b7280 on background #f4d9d9, contrastRatio 3.63 < 4.5 required (WCAG 2 AA, wcag143, RGAA-3.2.1). 9 distinct order-card nodes affected.
findings.recommendation: V1.0.X — Heal CSS for .kds-card__shortcut to use darker grey (e.g., #4b5563) or change bg to white. Scope-minimal CSS-only fix.

findings.title: KDS scrollable-region-focusable — 1 region without keyboard access
findings.evidence: Scrollable region lacks tabindex=0 or interactive descendants. WCAG 2.1.1 (keyboard) + 2.1.3 (no exception).
findings.recommendation: V1.0.X — Add tabindex=0 + role to scrollable container in KDS board layout.

findings.title: Mobile A11y — region landmarks missing across all 12 surveyed pages (107 nodes)
findings.evidence: Rule region (moderate) fires 107 times across 12 mobile screens. Means content not wrapped in main/nav/header landmarks.
findings.recommendation: V1.0.X heal mobile/RN side (scope reportedly standalone). Defer if mobile owner-gate.

findings.title: Mobile A11y — nested-interactive 61 nodes (serious)
findings.evidence: Interactive controls nested within other interactive controls — focus/keyboard confusion.
findings.recommendation: V1.0.X — refactor menu filter chips + modal dialog buttons to flat interactive structure.

findings.title: Mobile A11y — button-name 60 nodes (critical) on menu filter
findings.evidence: Buttons without discernible text — 60 nodes — likely icon-only buttons missing aria-label.
findings.recommendation: V1.0.X — add aria-label to icon-only filter buttons in mobile menu screen.

findings.title: Stale-copy fr=en (20 keys identical between fr.json and en.json with length>2)
findings.reproduction: node flatten diff for identical string values
findings.evidence: Keys like allergens.gluten, allergens.lupin, a11y.skip_to_cart, admin.help.* identical fr/en — could be intentional (proper nouns) or actual stale-copy bug.
findings.recommendation: V1.0.X — owner-review case-by-case. Allergens probably intentional, admin.help.* probably stale.

findings.title: Stale-copy fr=ar (12 keys identical between fr.json and ar.json)
findings.reproduction: node flatten diff identical string values
findings.evidence: Keys like label.siret, label.ssl, label.tls, label.rtl, label.ltr, label.paypal, label.pos, button.excel — proper nouns/abbreviations. Likely intentional.
findings.recommendation: V1.0.X — owner review; most are likely intentional proper nouns.
